idea: Week two, from the story bank: written from the tables, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: At end-March 2025 loans used in Andhra Pradesh were 157.2% of deposits held there (₹157 per ₹100): the highest of 35 states and UTs, 1.31 times Tamil Nadu and Telangana (both 120.5%) against India 80.1%, and the highest in each year since 2019.

Credit-deposit ratio by place of utilisation. 100 means loans equal deposits. Blank: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu (no figure in the table). Not a measure of whether lending is good or bad. The table shows how much, not why.
